text.text_excerpt: We have a friend that, whenever she comes to town, she likes to try new places. Last week, it was Crescent Pie & Sausage. I can't believe we hadn't been here before but it sure won't be the last time! We shared a lot of items, starting with a link of house-made pork sausage w/garlic. It was a little dry but otherwise had great flavor. We shared the pan-fried mac'n'cheese. It was huge, plenty big enough for three people to share as a side or appetizer and it was the BEST mac'n'cheese I have had, anywhere! Brown, crunchy top with creamy, cheesy macaroni, it was perfect. We shared the vegetable & seafood pies. I thought the seafood was a little bland, but the buttery, flaky crust was so good...

I went with a group of girls and we ordered a bunch of stuff and tried a little of everything. The duck and brie pizza is brilliant. The cheese and sausage plate was delicious. The black jambalaya was sooooo good. Someone ordered the turkey and chicken muffaletta, but I didn't try it. Looked good and she really liked it. The best part: MAC & CHEESE. Best in town. We got to meet the chef/ owner, Bart. Super nice guy! Their mac....omg.

They have the best margherita pizza in the city, and it's even better if you add italian sausage to it. (and, I know, that makes it NOT a margherita). Anyway, it was delicious. We sat outside at a good sized table. The beer servings are a little small (I believe they were less than a pint) We got a salad which was very large and easy to share. The service was excellent as well.
